verdict.rationale: The ingestion docs say the s3() and url() table functions 'work as documented', which points to reading files directly from object storage. However, they appear only in an ingestion context, with no explicit statement about querying data in place or about which formats are supported. Missing for 10: any mention of Iceberg or Delta Lake support, explicit Parquet querying in place without loading, documentation of open-table-format catalogs or engines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can query open table formats and files in object storage — Iceberg, Delta, Parquet — without first loading them into proprietary storage

citations.quote: the s3() and url() table functions, materialized views, all work as documented
